caption:
Sciatica flaring and wondering if Pilates is off the table? Usually it isn't.

Current guidelines suggest staying gently active with sciatica, and most people settle over weeks to months. Calm, controlled movement can help the nerve feel less sensitive along the way.

Hybi's 1-minute start: lie on your back with knees bent and do 10 slow pelvic tilts, twice a day. A mild ache that settles within a day is often okay. Sharper or spreading pain, or new numbness, means ease off and adjust. Saddle numbness, bladder or bowel changes, or worsening leg weakness need prompt medical attention first.

Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio works alongside our physios to match the program to you. Book online via the link in bio.
